content.text: {"summary":"To make the network compute f_old(q, v, 1.5u), I multiplied every first-layer weight on the force input u (column 2 of W1) by 1.5. Rows 1 and 6 already have zero weight on u, so they are unchanged. The biases, the q and v weights, and the output layer are left as they were, so everything else about the function stays the same. For the damping estimate, I took the derivative of the output with respect to v at the origin, using only the units active there. That gives about -0.77, so c is roughly 0.77. This is a rough figure: it assumes the a·v·|v| term contributes nothing to the slope at v=0, and the fitted network is only approximate.","estimated_c":0.77,"patches":[{"tensor":"W1","index":[0,2],"value":-0.190305015},{"tensor":"W1","index":[2,2],"value":1.540852785},{"tensor":"W1","index":[3,2],"value":-2.633168175},{"tensor":"W1","index":[4,2],"value":3.045295005},{"tensor":"W1","index":[5,2],"value":-0.00606396},{"tensor":"W1","index":[7,2],"value":0.087668385},{"tensor":"W1","index":[8,2],"value":0.300441765},{"tensor":"W1","index":[9,2],"value":-1.14950379},{"tensor":"W1","index":[10,2],"value":-0.355288215},{"tensor":"W1","index":[11,2],"value":0.752531835},{"tensor":"W1","index":[12,2],"value":0.004103805},{"tensor":"W1","index":[13,2],"value":0.822677835}]}
